This establishes unsuccessful acquisition followed by empty transport rather than a completed pickup. No renewed approach is visible before the window boundary; the behavior may continue beyond it.

failure_annotations.severity_evidence: The can remains accessible on the tabletop, with no visible spill, new damage, or disruption to the bowls or trays.
failure_annotations.resetability_evidence: Another grasp can be attempted directly from the can’s current tabletop position without an environmental reset.
